title: Aon Draws $65 Billion of Demand for Bond to Fund USI Acquisition
summary: Aon Plc’s debt offering to fund its planned acquisition of USI Insurance Services attracted demand roughly five times the size of the deal, indicating strong investor appetite for one of the biggest M&A financings of 2026.

title: Puig Agrees to Take Control of Isdin in €1.2 Billion Deal
summary: Puig Brands SA agreed to buy the 50% of Isdin SA it didn’t already own for €1.2 billion ($1.4 billion), giving it full control of the skincare brand.

title: China Passes Halfway Mark of US Soybean Pledge Ahead of Xi Visit
summary: China has fulfilled more than half of its annual US soybean purchase pledge, offering a bright spot for trade between the world’s two largest economies ahead of President Xi Jinping’s visit to Washington.

title: US 10-Year Breaches 5% as Inflation, Supply Worries Mount
summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield briefly surpassed 5% for the first time since 2023 on Monday, as mounting inflation angst collided with swelling government and corporate borrowing needs.

title: Junk Firms Plot $13 Billion Debt Refinancings as Rate Hikes Loom
summary: Junk-rated borrowers across the globe are lining up at least $13 billion in refinancing deals, in a bid to lock in tighter credit spreads ahead of potential central bank interest-rate hikes.

title: Oil Tankers Earn $1 Million a Day as War Leaves Ship Shortage
summary: The cost of hiring an oil tanker on the industry’s benchmark trade route topped $1 million a day for the first time, as the Iran war leaves too few ships willing to cross the Strait of Hormuz to collect cargoes.

title: Oil Surges as Saudi Pipeline Shutdown Brings Fresh Supply Risk
summary: Oil surged as Saudi Arabia’s closure of a major crude pipeline following attacks jolted the market, with the move disrupting a route that’s been key to bypassing the Strait of Hormuz during the US-Iran war. Bloomberg's Rob Barnett joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Emerging-Market Assets Fall as Oil Surge, AI Jitters Dent Mood
summary: Emerging-market assets fell at the start of a key week for global markets, as rising oil prices and concerns over the pace of artificial-intelligence development weighed on currencies and stocks ahead of an expected Federal Reserve interest-rate hike — its first since 2023.

title: AI Scare Threatens Fund Flows Beating Rest of Market 13-to-1
summary: For months, AI-obsessed investors have thrown billions of dollars into technology stocks and largely ignored the rest of the stock market. Monday’s rout in the sector following calls by industry leaders to temped the pace of development in the technology was a reminder of the case for diversification.

title: Tariffs Forced Nissan to Speed U.S. Production, Says Americas Chairman

title: Saudis Seek to Boost Hormuz Oil Exports as Key Pipeline Attacked
summary: Saudi Arabia is seeking to further boost oil supply through the Strait of Hormuz after attacks forced it to halt a key pipeline that’s been the main means of getting its crude to global markets during the Iran war, according to a person familiar with the matter.

title: BofA’s Subramanian Lifts S&P 500 View to 7,400, Stays Cautious
